tasks.label: start-opencode-runtime
args: pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:4096 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then kill $pids; sleep 1; fi; exec /Users/wanglei/.opencode/bin/opencode serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4096 --print-logs

tasks.label: start-web-ui-bff
args: pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:4098 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then kill $pids; sleep 1; fi; cd control-plane/web-ui-bff && exec bun run dev

background.endsPattern: Started development server: http://localhost:4098|OpenerX BFF running on http://localhost:4098

tasks.label: start-web-ui
args: pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then kill $pids; fi; fallback=$(lsof -ti tcp:5174 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [[ -n "$fallback" ]]; then kill $fallback; fi; sleep 1; cd control-plane/web-ui && exec bun run dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173

tasks.label: stop-opencode-runtime
args: pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:4096 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then kill $pids; fi

tasks.label: stop-web-ui-bff
args: pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:4098 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then kill $pids; fi

tasks.label: stop-web-ui
args: pids=$(lsof -ti tcp:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then kill $pids; fi; fallback=$(lsof -ti tcp:5174 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [[ -n "$fallback" ]]; then kill $fallback; fi
